text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "La Section allemande des Services linguistiques centraux veille à ce que tous les actes normatifs de la Confédération soient formulés de manière précise, claire, cohérente et aussi simple que possible.", "gist": "The German Section of the Central Language Services ensures federal regulations are precise, clear, consistent, and as simple as possible."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Services linguistiques centraux, Section française", "gist": "French Section of the Central Language Services"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "La Section française des Services linguistiques centraux partage ses activités entre rédaction législative, traduction et révision pour le compte du Parlement, du Conseil fédéral, des départements et de la Chancellerie fédérale.", "gist": "The French Section of the Central Language Services handles legislative drafting, translation, and revision for Parliament, the Federal Council, departments, and the Federal Chancellery."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Services linguistiques centraux, Division italienne", "gist": "Italian Division of the Central Language Services"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "C’est à la Division italienne qu’incombe l’élaboration de la version italienne de la législation fédérale.", "gist": "The Italian Division is responsible for drafting the Italian version of federal legislation."}]}
